dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Smoothly enough, I suppose. Before arriving at Ritou, my previous research topic was "The Practical Uses of the Energy Amplifier."

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Although things went wrong and our research sample was destroyed, we were able to rescue the situation by recovering some sample data.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I have you to thank for that save, Traveler.
